versions.changelog:
Initial release of the implement skill: a streamlined, isolated flow for building features or fixes in a new worktrunk worktree.

- Automatically scopes, implements, commits, and opens a draft PR for code changes based on user requests.
- Skips for questions, explanations, research, or trivial one-line doc/config edits.
- Detects and uses repo conventions for branch names and commit style.
- Starts dev server if available and reports live preview URL.
- Stays in the new worktree to support iterative review and further edits.
- Includes clear guidelines for cleanup and when not to use the skill.
